answer_1.quote: We take advantage of the linguistic abilities of LLMs to convert the trees generated by our grammar into posts. We generate a first draft using Vicuna-30B-Uncensored... We refine them using GPT-3.5-Turbo.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic hate speech posts with associated parse trees

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model performance on the intent classification task... using Micro F1... We also report performance using the AAA... metric... We evaluate model performance on the full ICSF task by measuring production F1 (PF1) and tree exact match accuracy (EMA).

answer_4.quote: To validate the use of this data, we recruit a domain expert to assess whether: (1) a post is fluent, (2) the assigned classification label is correct, (3) the associated tree is accurate, and (4) the slot labels are correct.
